name: AISIX AI Gateway Overview
description: Monitor open-source AISIX AI Gateway traffic, latency, token throughput, policy outcomes, and operational health from Prometheus metrics.

pages.name: AISIX AI Gateway Overview
pages.description: Core traffic, model, policy, and gateway health signals.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(aisix_requests_total), 1 minute) AS 'Requests per minute' WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'prometheus' AND instrumentation.name = 'remote-write' AND instrumentation.source = 'aisix-ai-gateway' FACET model TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(aisix_requests_total), 1 minute) AS 'Requests per minute' WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'prometheus' AND instrumentation.name = 'remote-write' AND instrumentation.source = 'aisix-ai-gateway' FACET outcome TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT bucketPercentile(aisix_request_e2e_latency_seconds_bucket, 50, 95, 99) WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'prometheus' AND instrumentation.name = 'remote-write' AND instrumentation.source = 'aisix-ai-gateway' FACET model TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT bucketPercentile(aisix_request_ttft_seconds_bucket, 50, 95, 99) WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'prometheus' AND instrumentation.name = 'remote-write' AND instrumentation.source = 'aisix-ai-gateway' FACET model TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Token throughput by model and type

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(aisix_llm_tokens_by_client_total), 1 minute) AS 'Tokens per minute' WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'prometheus' AND instrumentation.name = 'remote-write' AND instrumentation.source = 'aisix-ai-gateway' FACET model, token_type TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(aisix_cache_requests_total), 1 minute) AS 'Cache requests per minute' WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'prometheus' AND instrumentation.name = 'remote-write' AND instrumentation.source = 'aisix-ai-gateway' FACET outcome TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT rate(sum(aisix_guardrail_blocks_total), 1 minute) AS 'Blocked requests per minute' WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'prometheus' AND instrumentation.name = 'remote-write' AND instrumentation.source = 'aisix-ai-gateway' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT latest(aisix_config_last_reload_successful) AS 'Reload successful' WHERE instrumentation.provider = 'prometheus' AND instrumentation.name = 'remote-write' AND instrumentation.source = 'aisix-ai-gateway'
